scope: Finite cutoff and every fixed positive density floor for the hash-pinned L=16 A1 six-real production model; common real-even mutually orthogonal one-shot sharp shells; regular bounded cylindrical strict-past controls; pointwise/marginal target-space heat-value coupling; and the fixed-torus inhomogeneous H2 centered-form theorem inherited from R-068. Progressive range revisits and arbitrary finite-energy drifts are excluded.

theorem.affine_tangent_no_go: For B(z)=sum_A M_A(z)Q M_A(z)^T, uniform lower boundedness of the old affine derivative-displacement quadratic requires [B(z+a)-B(z)]y in Ran B(z+a). Rotating production phase kernels violate this condition. In the exact active-doublet fixture the raw secant is zero while the affine tangent is beta_0 epsilon t and the remainder is -beta_0 epsilon t.
theorem.endpoint_identity: With L_A=DM_A(z)[a]^T y+M_A(z+a)^T b and E_A=[M_A(z+a)-M_A(z)-DM_A(z)[a]]^T y, the exact current increment is delta_A=L_A+E_A. The curvature remainder E_A is independent of b.
theorem.frame_jets: Uniformly in the density floor, ||M_A(z)||_F<=sqrt(8)|z|, ||DM_A(z)[h]||_F<=sqrt(68)|h|, and ||D2M_A(z)[h,k]||_F<=32|h||k|/sqrt(|z|^2+e).
theorem.optimized_bounds: The optimized safe good/bad envelope has theta_#=2/(1+sqrt(1+32sqrt(2))) and C_#=3 lambda_Q(1+sqrt(1+32sqrt(2)))^2=1.0196115487028556. The global endpoint-lifted bound has theta_*=sqrt(34)/(sqrt(34)+4sqrt(2)) and C_*=24 lambda_Q(sqrt(34)+4sqrt(2))=1.5397534378598672. These optimize the stated safe envelopes and are not asserted globally sharp.
theorem.causal_grouping: For one coherent target-space heat value U at every shell, exact polarization splits the current secant into CC, GG, and mixed pieces. CC telescopes pathwise. The fresh derivative-noise correction in the mixed piece centers in expectation by strict-past predictability and same-point value--derivative independence. The terminal mixed current is retained with the terminal CC and GG pieces.
theorem.gaussian_only_lift: Applying the endpoint lift only to the Gaussian derivative gives R_j^G>=T_j^G+J_j^G-C_*|a_j|^2|G_j|^2. No accumulated control derivative occurs. The centered scalar component of the displayed defect transfers by conditional expectation to one terminal pairing with Pi_0=sum_j|a_j|^2; the R-068 sum-first interpolation and Young inequality pay it once, and the covariance trace is summable.
theorem.pure_control_payment_no_go: For a_N=tN cos(Nx) and a_2N=tN cos(2Nx) on the normalized circle, the separate defect, leading H2 cost, and terminal L6 sixth power all scale as N^6 with coefficients t^4/4, 17t^2/2, and 215t^6/32. Arbitrarily small prescribed budgets leave a positive coefficient, so the exact CC telescope is essential.
theorem.remaining_form: The remaining sufficient target is the adapted Gaussian-rooted transported-current/GG lower bound with the terminal control-current square, mixed secant, and finite-low boundary retained. Only the genuinely centered scalar component may be reduced to the pinned R-068 global quadratic form plus covariance trace.
